name: The IT Crowd
description: The comedic misadventures of Roy, Moss, and their grifting supervisor Jen, a 'motley crew' of IT support workers at a large corporation headed by a hotheaded yuppie.

videos.title: The Internet Is Coming
videos.overview: The reputation of Reynholm Industries is put at risk after an incident involving spilt coffee and a homeless person ends up being posted on the Internet. When Douglas shares the secret of his confidence, a newly transformed Moss comes up with a plan to help Jen and Roy but everything seems too good to be true.

videos.title: The IT Crowd Manual
videos.overview: This behind-the-scenes documentary features interviews with the main cast of the cult comedy The IT Crowd, plus a host of celebrity fans.

videos.title: Series 1 Deleted Scenes
videos.overview: A collection of deleted scenes from Series 1. Featured on the Season 1 DVD.

videos.title: Series 1 Outtakes
videos.overview: A collection of outtakes and bloopers from Series 1. Featured on the Season 1 DVD.

videos.title: Behind The IT Crowd
videos.overview: A behind the scenes documentary on the creation of the first series of The IT Crowd. Featured on the Season 1 DVD.

videos.title: A Day in the Life of The IT Crowd
videos.overview: A short documentary narrated by the producers of The IT Crowd, Ash Atalla and Jamie Glazebrook. Showcasing how the series is filmed in front of a live studio audience and what goes into making the show. Series creator Graham Linehan also stars. Featured on the Season 2 DVD.

videos.title: Series 2 Outtakes
videos.overview: A collection of outtakes and bloopers from Series 2. Featured on the Season 2 DVD.

videos.title: The Original Title Sequence
videos.overview: A brief clip showcasing the original title sequence before it changed into the one we know today. Featured on the Season 3 DVD.

videos.title: Series 3 Deleted Scene 2 "Roy's Sex Life"
videos.overview: Roy points out a bird, though at first Moss thinks he's referring to a man in drag. Roy pulls her, and isn't put off when he discovers she's drunk, or even when she mentions her jealous ex-husband.

videos.title: Series 3 Outtakes
videos.overview: A collection of outtakes and bloopers from Series 3. Featured on the Season 3 DVD.

videos.title: Cracking the IT Crowd
videos.overview: In the Series 2 DVD, there was a hidden competition buried within the disc itself. Head of IT Sean Sollé explains how it worked.

videos.title: Set Tour
videos.overview: Creator Graham Linehan and Runner Ben Capel give a tour of the set of The IT Crowd and the influence its viewers had on what appears in Roy, Moss and Jen's office space. Featured on the Season 3 DVD.

videos.title: An Interview with Graham
videos.overview: A bonus feature comprising of an interview with series creator Graham Linehan on where the show is at the end of filming Series 3. Featured on the Season 3 DVD.

videos.title: Series 3 Deleted Scene 1 "Look After Yourself"
videos.overview: 'Look After Yourself' is a self defence video created by Moss' friends for you to heed in the event of you ever being in danger. Listed as a deleted scene in the Season 3 DVD.

videos.title: Series 4 Outtakes
videos.overview: A collection of outtakes and bloopers from Series 4. Featured on the Season 4 DVD.

videos.title: Kalypso - Sweet Billy Pilgrim
videos.overview: The official music video for 'Kalypso' by Sweet Billy Pilgrim, featuring Katherine Parkinson on backing vocals. Featured on the Season 4 DVD.

videos.title: The IT Crowd On Location
videos.overview: A mini documentary showcasing the makings of Series 4 Episode 2 'The Final Countdown' and all that went into filming the show on location. Featuring interviews with Richard Boden (Producer and Director), Graham Linehan (Creator) and more. Featured on the Season 4 DVD.

videos.title: A Menu Homage
videos.overview: A collection of interviews about the DVD menu screens. Featuring Dave Whyte (Director of Animation), Sean Sollé (IT Consultant), Stuart Livesey (DVD Authoring) and Graham Linehan (Creator). Featured on the Season 4 DVD.

videos.title: Hello Friend
videos.overview: Hello Friend, sometimes written as Hello, Friend, is a short comedy horror film directed by Graham Linehan and written by Linehan and Robert Popper. The film was Linehan's directorial debut. The film stars Martin Savage as a man, John Ward, but credited as the "Subject", who buys some new internet software for his computer, which begins to take over his life. The film was produced by The Film Council, Film4 Productions, and Shine Limited. Included as a bonus feature on the Season 1 DVD.

videos.title: Random Access Memories
videos.overview: A retrospective featurette that offers an overview of the series, including its development, through clips and interviews with Linehan, Ayoade, O'Dowd, Parkinson, Berry and Fielding

videos.title: Music Demo
videos.overview: The Music Demo from Series 2

videos.title: Recording the IT Crowd
videos.overview: A behind-the-scenes special feature from the Season 2 DVD.

videos.title: Do It Yourself
videos.overview: A DIY short from Dr. Mike Thorne release in Season 2 as an Easter Egg on the DVD series explaining inputting data into a computer by constructing a phototransistor that can suction to your TV screen.

videos.title: Yesterday's Jam
videos.overview: It's Jen's first day at Reynholm Industries and she is assigned the position of manager of the IT department. Roy and Moss quickly find out that she has absolutely no knowledge of computers whatsoever.

videos.title: Calamity Jen
videos.overview: Denholm tries to reduce stress in the work place and invites a stress expert to give the employees a class about dealing with stress. Meanwhile, Jen buys new shoes that are a few sizes too small, which leads to a very painful result.

videos.title: Fifty-Fifty
videos.overview: Moss and Roy go on a lonely hearts website. Meanwhile Jen meets the man of her dreams.

videos.title: The Red Door
videos.overview: What lies behind the mysterious red door in the IT department? What has happened to Moss's new mug? And why is Roy in danger of becoming known as a 'desk rabbit'?

videos.title: The Haunting of Bill Crouse
videos.overview: When her date Bill turns out to be a jerk, Jen asks Moss to send him away if he stops by. When he does and Moss can't convince him to leave, Moss has to lie and ends up telling Bill that Jen is dead.

videos.title: Aunt Irma Visits
videos.overview: Roy and Moss get the same symptoms as Jen when it's her time of the month.

videos.title: The Work Outing
videos.overview: Jen is asked out on a date by Philip, and Roy and Moss decide to tag along, which ruins any chance of romance Jen was hoping for.

videos.title: Return of the Golden Child
videos.overview: Moss uses a website to calculate Roy's time of death, but Roy doesn't want to know. Nevertheless Moss spills it anyway, making Roy very nervous. Meanwhile, Denholm's death means trouble for Jen, Roy and Moss, until support appears in the form of a mysterious, albeit libidinous, stranger.

videos.title: Moss and the German
videos.overview: Moss decides to sign himself up for a German cookery course, but due to a slight miscommunication between Moss and the advertiser, it turns out to be something else entirely.  Roy tries to see a film before someone can spoil the ending for him.  Jen finds out smoking is not as glamorous as she used to think.

videos.title: The Dinner Party
videos.overview: Jen's attempt to throw a successful dinner party don't go exactly the way she was hoping. The evening isn't a total disaster for everyone, though, as Richmond meets the woman of his dreams.

videos.title: Smoke and Mirrors
videos.overview: When Jen complains about her bad bra, Moss attempts to create the world's most perfect bra. When he succeeds, he attempts to get onto the BBC show Dragon's Den to demonstrate it, which turns out a bit awkward.

videos.title: Men Without Women
videos.overview: After making several unsuccessful advances, Douglas offers Jen the job as his new PA in order to get even closer to her. This way he hopes to slip a potion in her tea, that he obtained from a sorcerer and which should make Douglas irresistable to Jen.

videos.title: From Hell
videos.overview: Douglas's neglegance in running the company nearly ruins Reynholm Industries. Meanwhile, Jen has a builder over at her house to do some renovations. When Roy seems to remember the guy from being on a TV show "Builders from hell", Jen gets a bit nervous.

videos.title: Are We Not Men?
videos.overview: Roy and Moss try to meet new friends by getting familiar with the latest football news and slang. They meet new, yet peculiar friends. Meanwhile, Jen dates a guy who looks like a magician.

videos.title: Tramps Like Us
videos.overview: When a sexual harassment case ends with a low pay out, Jen, Roy and Moss find themselves all moving in different directions.

videos.title: The Speech
videos.overview: Jen makes enemies of Roy and Moss after trying to assert herself more after being named as Employee of the Month. Douglas discovers that the woman who he loves is not quite as she seems.

videos.title: Friendface
videos.overview: The boys are introduced to a social networking website by Jen.  Through the site they get in touch with old acquaintances to which they brag a little bit too much, which leads to awkward situations.

videos.title: Calendar Geeks
videos.overview: To raise money for charity, the girls of the 7th floor come up with the idea to do a nude calendar. Roy -who happens to be there to fix a computer- gets excited when the girls ask him to do the photography. Jen doesn't like the idea so much and comes up with an alternative.

videos.title: Jen the Fredo
videos.overview: Jen decides she wants to stretch herself more at work and applies for the post of Entertainment Manager. After discovering that her boss Douglas's business connections have wilder tastes than she planned for, she ends up turning to Moss and Roy for help.

videos.title: The Final Countdown
videos.overview: Moss ends up becoming a celebrity after he beats all the records on a popular daytime quiz show. Roy tries to explain to an old mate after being mistaken for a window cleaner. Jen finds herself pre-occupied with Douglas' secret head of department meetings.

videos.title: Something Happened
videos.overview: Douglas finds himself becoming a Spaceologist. Some bad luck changes Roy's life. Jen ends up getting involved with a rock band.

videos.title: Italian for Beginners
videos.overview: Roy gets obsessed by his latest girlfriend's sad family history, while Jen tells an absolute whopper to get some attention.

videos.title: Bad Boys
videos.overview: When Roy and Moss become juvenile delinquents for the day they end up having an uncomfortable experience at a local shopping centre.

videos.title: Reynholm vs Reynholm
videos.overview: Douglas discovers that marriage agrees with him for all of a fortnight. He then finds himself in court defending himself with Jen, Roy and Moss' help.
